verdict.rationale: RevenueCat supports free-trial eligibility checks, entitlements, and granting promotional subscriptions, and webhooks could be used to build custom trial-reminder logic, but there is no documented native coupon/promo-code management or built-in trial-end notification feature — in fact a community post explicitly requests this as a missing feature ('handling timed hooks to send notifications... reminding users before a trial expires'). missing for 10: native coupon/promo-code support, built-in trial-end notification delivery, card-network compliance documentation.
